check: receipt digests against a clean git checkout
why: verify_receipts.py hashes the working tree, which is what passed while 17 of 25 receipts described CRLF bytes that no checkout of this repository produces. This mode hashes what a clone materialises instead: git applies .gitattributes on checkout, so these are the bytes another machine receives.
zstd_authority: the decompressed raw sha256 in raw-evidence-manifest.json remains authoritative for packed artifacts; git stores them untouched under the *.zst binary rule
